title: MigrateCheckDoc
description: The `--migrate-check-json` document (schema 1). Field order is alphabetical to match the historical `serde_json` map output (no `preserve_order`), so the emitted bytes are unchanged by the move to typed structs.

parallel.description: Parallel-phase result: `null` when the phase was skipped (WILL-bail ids force `-n 0`) or could not capture outcomes.

ready.description: Whether the suite is parallel-ready (no blocking findings).

tests_collected.description: Tests collected (union across the two collection runs).

unstable_ids.description: Unstable-nodeid findings, grouped by test site.

will_bail_count.description: Count of per-process-unstable ids that force `-n 0`.

allowed.description: Whether this nodeid is on the allow list.

polluter.description: The bisected polluter, or `null` when none was found.

why.description: Why it fails only under parallelism.

MigrateMeta.description: Envelope metadata for the migrate-check document.

ParallelReport.description: Result of the `-n auto` parallel phase. Fields other than `ran` are absent when the phase did not actually run to completion.

preexisting.description: Tests that already fail at `-n 0` (pre-existing, not a parallelism bug).

ran.description: Whether the parallel phase actually ran.

ready.description: Whether it passed (present only once the phase ran).

PolluterJson.description: A finding's polluter: the file that, run first, reproduces the failure.

UnstableSite.description: One unstable-nodeid finding, grouped by test site (`file::test`).

allowed.description: Whether this site is on the `--allow-unstable` list.

fix.description: The upstream fix for the worst instability kind here.

kinds.description: Count of unstable ids at this site, keyed by instability kind.

sample.description: A sample parametrize id from this site.

will_bail.description: Whether the site WILL bail at `-n auto` (per-process-unstable id).
